requirements.text: The rear combination lamp shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraphs 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6.
requirements.quote: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraphs 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp shall have all markings clearly legible and indelible.
requirements.quote: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible,

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp shall have a value for "a" of the approval marking size of at least 5 mm.
requirements.quote: With regard to the size of the approval marking the value for “a” shall be at least 5 mm.

requirements.text: The approval marking of the rear combination lamp shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
requirements.quote: The approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.

requirements.text: The approval marking of the rear combination lamp shall consist of the four to six-digit sequential number, being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
requirements.quote: The four to six-digit sequential number, being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.

requirements.text: The sequential number of the rear combination lamp shall be placed close to the approval mark.
requirements.quote: This sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.

requirements.text: The approval marking of the rear combination lamp shall consist of the number of this Regulation followed by the letter 'R' and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
requirements.quote: The number of this Regulation followed by the letter 'R' and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.

requirements.text: Where the rear combination lamp cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, the approval marking shall include, as an additional symbol, a horizontal arrow showing in which position the lamp is to be mounted.
requirements.quote: On lamps which cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, a horizontal arrow showing in which position the lamp is to be mounted.

requirements.text: Where the rear combination lamp cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately and the horizontal arrow is used, the arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle in the case of: (a) direction indicators categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c and 12; (b) front or rear position lamps, front or rear end-outline marker lamps; (c) reversing lamps in case of reduced light distribution of two reversing lamps.
requirements.quote: The arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle in the case of: (a) Direction indicators categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c and 12; (b) Front or rear position lamps, front or rear end-outline marker lamps; (c) Reversing lamps in case of reduced light distribution of two reversing lamps.

requirements.text: Where applicable, the approval marking of the rear combination lamp shall include, to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4., the additional letter "D" on lamps which may be used as part of an assembly of two independent lamps.
requirements.quote: (a) The additional letter "D", on lamps which may be used as part of an assembly of two independent lamps;

requirements.text: Where applicable, the approval marking of the rear combination lamp shall include, to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4., the additional letter "Y" on lamps which are used as part of an interdependent lamps system.
requirements.quote: (b) The additional letter "Y", on lamps which are used as part of an interdependent lamps system.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp shall bear the approval marking.
requirements.quote: Lamps shall bear the approval marking.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.quote: Lamps shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp, with the exception of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, shall bear a marking indicating the category or categories of light source(s) prescribed.
requirements.quote: Lamps shall, with the exception of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, bear a marking indicating: (a) The category or categories of light source(s) prescribed;

requirements.text: Where the rear combination lamp has been approved for LED substitute light source(s), the rear combination lamp, with the exception of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, shall bear a marking indicating the category or categories of the LED substitute light source(s).
requirements.quote: (b) in the case where the lamp has been approved for LED substitute light source(s), also the category or categories of the LED substitute light source(s);

requirements.text: Where the rear combination lamp has an electronic light source control gear, and/or a variable luminous intensity control, and/or a secondary operating mode, and/or non-replaceable light sources, the rear combination lamp shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
requirements.quote: Lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage, in the case of lamps with: (a) An electronic light source control gear; and/or (b) A variable luminous intensity control; and/or (c) A secondary operating mode; and/or (d) Non-replaceable light sources.

requirements.text: Where an electronic light source control gear or variable luminous intensity control is part of the rear combination lamp but not included into the lamp body, the electronic light source control gear or variable luminous intensity control shall be marked with its identification number and the name of the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: An electronic light source control gear or variable luminous intensity control being part of the lamp, but not included into the lamp body, shall be marked with its identification number and the name of the manufacturer.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the rear combination lamp which is not designed to be separated from the transparent part of the lamp emitting the light.
requirements.quote: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp which is not designed to be separated from the transparent part of the lamp emitting the light.

requirements.text: In any case, the approval marking as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the rear combination lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.
requirements.quote: In any case the approval marking as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.

requirements.text: If the outer lens of a device is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on both, the detachable lens and the main body.
requirements.quote: If the outer lens of a device is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on both, the detachable lens and the main body.

requirements.text: In case an outer lens is used for several devices and bearing different approval markings, the main body of each device shall bear only the approval marking of the function(s) of that device.
requirements.quote: In case an outer lens is used for several devices and bearing different approval markings, the main body of each device shall bear only the approval marking of the function(s) of that device.

requirements.text: The approval marking and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.2., 3.3.3.3., 3.3.3.4., 3.3.3.5. (b) and 3.3.3.6. shall be affixed on the rear combination lamp.
requirements.quote: The approval marking and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.2., 3.3.3.3., 3.3.3.4., 3.3.3.5. (b) and 3.3.3.6. shall be affixed on the lamp.

requirements.text: The markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.5.(a) shall be affixed on the component.
requirements.quote: The markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.5.(a) shall be affixed on the component.

requirements.text: Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps have been found to comply with the requirements of several UN Regulations and a single approval mark is affixed, no part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light shall be removable without at the same time removing the approval mark.
requirements.quote: No part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark.

requirements.text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
requirements.quote: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.

requirements.text: The lamp submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
requirements.quote: Each lamp submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.

requirements.text: The lamp shall comply with the requirements contained in sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections) of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval.
requirements.quote: The requirements contained in sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections) of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval shall apply to this Regulation.

requirements.text: The requirements pertinent to each lamp and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the lamp is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.
requirements.quote: The requirements pertinent to each lamp and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the lamp is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.

requirements.text: The lamps shall be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured and they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The lamps must be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured and they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.

requirements.text: Where a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, the rear position lamp and stop lamp functions shall either: (a) be provided by multiple light sources (for instance, a double filament light source); or (b) be intended for use in a vehicle equipped with a tell-tale indicating failure for the lamps.
requirements.quote: However, in the case of a rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, these functions shall either: (a) be provided by multiple light sources (for instance, a double filament light source); or (b) be intended for use in a vehicle equipped with a tell-tale indicating failure for the lamps.

requirements.text: Where a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, a note shall be made within the communication document.
requirements.quote: In either case, a note shall be made within the communication document.

requirements.text: Where the internal structure of the optical components and/or the texture of the outer lens of a lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo at the request of the applicant, the lamp shall fulfil all requirements for the specific function of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: may incorporate only one manufacturer logo build by transparent or non-transparent components provided that all requirements for the specific function of this Regulation are fulfilled and in addition the following conditions

requirements.text: Where a lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall incorporate only one logo.
requirements.quote: may incorporate only one manufacturer logo build by transparent or non-transparent components

requirements.text: Where a lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo, only the logo of the brand name of the vehicle manufacturer or the body manufacturer shall be used, irrespective of the marking requirements in paragraph 3.3., and this shall be confirmed by the applicant by a statement (see paragraph 3.1.2.2. (f)).
requirements.quote: (a) Irrespective of the marking requirements in paragraph 3.3., only the logo of the brand name of the vehicle manufacturer or the body manufacturer is allowed. This shall be confirmed by the applicant by a statement (see paragraph 3.1.2.2. (f)).

requirements.text: Where a lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo, the enclosed light emitting surface of the logo (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) of the lamp in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 100 cm2.
requirements.quote: (b) Size: the enclosed light emitting surface of the logo (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) of such a lamp in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 100 cm2.

requirements.text: The stop lamp, direction indicator lamp, and reversing lamp shall not incorporate a logo.
requirements.quote: (d) Stop lamps, direction indicator lamps, and reversing lamps shall not incorporate a logo.

requirements.text: In case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, the lamp shall satisfy at least one of the following: (a) the light intensity complies with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3 and when all light sources are illuminated the maximum intensities are not exceeded; or (b) a signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure, as indicated in paragraphs 6.4.8., 6.7.8., 6.9.8, 6.10.8., 6.11.8., 6.12.8., 6.13.8. and 6.18.8. of UN Regulation No. 48, is produced, in which case a note in the communication form states that the lamp is only for use on a vehicle fitted with a tell-tale indicating failure.
requirements.quote: In case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, at least one of the following provisions shall apply:

requirements.text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a rear position lamp category R2 emitting more than the maximum value of category R1, a rear end-outline marker lamp category RM2 emitting more than the maximum value of category RM1, a stop lamp category S2 emitting more than the maximum value of category S1, a stop lamp category S4 emitting more than the maximum value of category S3, a direction indicator of category 2b emitting more than the maximum value of category 2a, or a rear fog lamp of category F2 emitting more than the maximum value of category F1, the requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.quote: Requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.

requirements.text: The lamp shall only be equipped with: replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128, provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval, and/or light source module(s) and/or non-replaceable light source(s).
requirements.quote: The lamp shall only be equipped with: - replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128, provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval, and/or - light source module(s) and/or - non-replaceable light source(s)

requirements.text: The light signalling devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances, which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: Light Signalling Devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances, which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the light source module shall be designed such that it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position and can only be removed with the use of tool(s).
requirements.quote: (a) it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position and can only be removed with the use of tool(s);

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the light source module shall be tamperproof.
requirements.quote: (b) it is tamperproof;

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the light source module shall be designed such that, regardless of the use of tool(s), it is not interchangeable with any replaceable UN approved light source and/or any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.
requirements.quote: (c) regardless of the use of tool(s), it is not interchangeable with: - any replaceable UN approved light source; and/or, - any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of the device shall be met.
requirements.quote: (d) when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of device shall be met.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp shall be measured, photometrically and colorimetrically, with respect to the following conditions (particulars of the methods of measurement to be used being given in Annex 3).
requirements.quote: All measurements, photometric and colorimetric, shall be made with respect to the following conditions.

requirements.text: In the case of a rear combination lamp equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), all measurements shall be made with the light source(s) present in the rear combination lamp.
requirements.quote: In the case of a lamp equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), all measurements shall be made with the light source(s) present in the lamp.

requirements.text: In the case where the rear combination lamp may be installed on the vehicle in more than one or in a field of different positions, the photometric measurements shall be repeated for each position or for the extreme positions of the field of the reference axis specified by the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: In the case where the lamp may be installed on the vehicle in more than one or in a field of different positions the photometric measurements shall be repeated for each position or for the extreme positions of the field of the reference axis specified by the manufacturer.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensities of the rear combination lamp shall be measured with the light source continuously lit.
requirements.quote: If not otherwise specified, the intensities shall be measured with the light source continuously lit.

requirements.text: The limits of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of each light-signalling lamp of the rear combination lamp shall be determined, except that for category 5 and 6 direction indicators the limits of the light emitting surface shall be determined, and except that this requirement shall not apply to rear-registration plate illuminating lamps.
requirements.quote: The limits of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of a light-signalling lamp shall be determined. However, in the case of category 5 and 6 direction indicators, the limits of the light emitting surface shall be determined. This requirement shall not apply to rear-registration plate illuminating lamps.

requirements.text: Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the rear combination lamp for testing shall be either 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems).
requirements.quote: Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the lamp shall be either 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems).

requirements.text: In case of a rear combination lamp controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the rear combination lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant for testing.
requirements.quote: In case of a lamp controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant

requirements.text: In case of a rear combination lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, in the case of light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), the rear combination lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
requirements.quote: 4.8.2.2.1. in the case of light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s) the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant;

requirements.text: The identification of an electronic light source control gear if applicable or variable intensity control if applicable and/or the voltage applied, including the tolerances, shall be noted in the communication form in Annex 1.
requirements.quote: The identification of an electronic light source control gear if applicable or variable intensity control if applicable and/or the voltage applied, including the tolerances, shall be noted in the communication form in Annex 1.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by the rear combination lamp, on the reference axis (HV), shall be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.quote: (a) On the reference axis (HV), be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.;

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by the rear combination lamp shall, in no direction where the lamp is visible, exceed the maximum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.quote: (b) In no direction where the lamp is visible, exceed the maximum, specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.;

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by the rear combination lamp, outside the reference axis, shall be not less than the product of the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5. by the percentage specified in the pertinent light distribution figure reproduced in Annex 3 for each direction in question, or not less than the intensity value as specified in the pertinent light distribution figure reproduced in Annex 3 for each direction in question.
requirements.quote: (c) Outside the reference axis, - be not less than the product of the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5., by the percentage specified in the pertinent light distribution figure reproduced in Annex 3 for each direction in question, or - be not less than the intensity value as specified in the pertinent light distribution figure reproduced in Annex 3 for each direction in question;

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by the rear combination lamp, within the angles of geometric visibility defined in the tables in Annex 2, shall be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.quote: (d) Within the angles of geometric visibility defined in the tables in Annex 2, be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.

requirements.text: The provisions of the relevant paragraphs of Annex 3 on local variations of intensity shall be observed for the rear combination lamp.
requirements.quote: The provisions of the relevant paragraphs of Annex 3 on local variations of intensity shall be observed.

requirements.text: If a rear position lamp and/or a rear end-outline marker lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp producing either steady or variable luminous intensity, the ratio between the luminous intensities actually measured of the two lamps when turned on simultaneously at the intensity of the rear position lamp or end-outline marker lamp when turned on alone should be at least 5:1 in the field delimited by the straight horizontal lines passing through ±5° V and the straight vertical lines passing through ±10° H of the light distribution table.
requirements.quote: If a rear position lamp and/or a rear end-outline marker lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp producing either steady or variable luminous intensity, the ratio between the luminous intensities actually measured of the two lamps when turned on simultaneously at the intensity of the rear position lamp or end-outline marker lamp when turned on alone should be at least 5:1 in the field delimited by the straight horizontal lines passing through ±5° V and the straight vertical lines passing through ±10° H of the light distribution table.

requirements.text: If one or both of the two reciprocally incorporated lamps contain(s) more than one light source and is (are) considered as a single lamp, the values to be considered shall be those obtained with all sources in operation.
requirements.quote: If the one or both of the two reciprocally incorporated lamps contain(s) more than one light source and is (are) considered as a single lamp, the values to be considered are those obtained with all sources in operation;

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp shall be tested for compliance of the luminous intensities according to Annex 8.
requirements.quote: Tests for compliance of the luminous intensities shall be carried out according to Annex 8.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp shall have the colour of the light emitted measured inside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function in the relevant paragraph of Annex 3.
requirements.quote: The colour of the light emitted shall be measured inside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function in the relevant paragraph of Annex 3.

requirements.text: To check the colorimetric characteristics of the rear combination lamp, the test procedure described in paragraph 4.8. shall be applied.
requirements.quote: To check these colorimetric characteristics, the test procedure described in paragraph 4.8. shall be applied.

requirements.text: Outside the field of the light distribution grid, no sharp variation of colour shall be observed on the rear combination lamp.
requirements.quote: Outside this field no sharp variation of colour shall be observed.

requirements.text: Where the rear combination lamp is equipped with non-replaceable light sources, the colorimetric characteristics should be verified with the light sources present in the lamp, in accordance with relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 4.8.
requirements.quote: However, for lamps equipped with non-replaceable light sources, the colorimetric characteristics should be verified with the light sources present in the lamp, in accordance with relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 4.8.

requirements.text: Where the rear combination lamp (functions) uses different light source technologies, the colorimetric characteristics of the lamp shall be checked for each light source technology separately according to the applicable provisions in paragraphs 4.8.1. and 4.8.2.
requirements.quote: For lamps (functions) using different light source technologies, the colorimetric characteristics shall be checked for each light source technology separately according to the applicable provisions in paragraphs 4.8.1. and 4.8.2.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of the rear position lamp shall meet the requirements in Table 4, except that a luminous intensity of 6.0∙10^1 cd shall be permitted for rear position lamps reciprocally incorporated with stop lamps below a plane forming an angle of 5° with and downward from the horizontal plane.
requirements.quote: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 4. However, a luminous intensity of 6.0∙101 cd shall be permitted for rear position lamps reciprocally incorporated with stop lamps below a plane forming an angle of 5° with and downward from the horizontal plane.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall meet the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility given in Table 4.
requirements.quote: Minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility: See Table 4

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall meet the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.
requirements.quote: Failure provisions: See paragraph 4.6.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall emit red light.
requirements.quote: The colour of light emitted shall be red.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of the stop lamp shall meet the requirements in Table 7.
requirements.quote: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 7.

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall meet the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility given in Table 7.
requirements.quote: Minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility See Table 7.

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall meet the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.
requirements.quote: Failure provisions: See paragraph 4.6.

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall emit red light.
requirements.quote: Colour: The colour of light emitted shall be red.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of the reversing lamp supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 10, except that where the reversing lamp is intended to be installed on a vehicle exclusively in a pair of devices, the photometric intensity may be verified only up to an angle of 30° inwards where a photometric value of at least 2.5∙10^1 cd shall be satisfied.
requirements.quote: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 10. However, in the case where the reversing lamp is intended to be installed on a vehicle exclusively in a pair of devices, the photometric intensity may be verified only up to an angle of 30° inwards where a photometric value of at least 2.5∙101 cd shall be satisfied.

requirements.text: Where the type approval is granted applying the condition of verifying the photometric intensity only up to an angle of 30° inwards, the condition shall be clearly explained in the application for approval and relating documents (see paragraph 3.1.).
requirements.quote: This condition shall be clearly explained in the application for approval and relating documents (see paragraph 3.1.).

requirements.text: Where the type approval is granted applying the condition of verifying the photometric intensity only up to an angle of 30° inwards, a statement in paragraph 9.1.3. of the communication form (see Annex 1) shall inform that the reversing lamp shall only be installed in a pair.
requirements.quote: Moreover, in the case where the type approval will be granted applying the condition above, a statement in paragraph 9.1.3. of the communication form (see Annex 1) will inform that the device shall only be installed in a pair.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp of category AR shall meet the luminous intensities of Table 10: minimum 8.0∙10^1 cd, maximum 3.00∙10^2 cd in or above the h-plane, 6.00∙10^2 cd below the h-plane down to 5°D, and 8.00∙10^3 cd below 5°D, with the standard light distribution of Figure A3-V.
requirements.quote: Table 10 Luminous intensities for reversing lamps Reversing lamps of category Minimum luminous intensity in cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)) Maximum luminous intensity in cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)) Standard light distribution (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)) ... AR 8.0∙101 3.00∙102 6.00∙102 8.00∙103 Figure A3-V N.A. N.A.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall emit white light.
requirements.quote: Colour: The colour of light emitted shall be white.

requirements.text: Unless specified otherwise, the values shown in Figures A3-I to A3-XV, which give for the various directions of measurement the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required, shall be mathematically rounded down to three significant digits.
requirements.quote: Unless specified otherwise, the values shown in Figures A3-I to A3-XV give, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required, which shall be mathematically rounded down to three significant digits.

requirements.text: Within the field of light distribution schematically shown as a grid, the light pattern of the lamp should be substantially uniform, i.e. the light intensity in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines shall meet at least the lowest minimum value being shown on the grid lines surrounding the questioned direction as a percentage.
requirements.quote: Within the field of light distribution schematically shown as a grid, the light pattern should be substantially uniform, i.e. the light intensity in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines shall meet at least the lowest minimum value being shown on the grid lines surrounding the questioned direction as a percentage.

requirements.text: In the case of reversing lamps, if visual examination of the lamp appears to reveal substantial local variations of intensity, a check shall be made to ensure that no intensity measured between two of the directions of measurement referred to above is below 50 per cent of the lower minimum intensity of the two prescribed for these directions of measurement.
requirements.quote: However, in the case of reversing lamps, if visual examination of a lamp appears to reveal substantial local variations of intensity, a check shall be made to ensure that no intensity measured between two of the directions of measurement referred to above is below 50 per cent of the lower minimum intensity of the two prescribed for these directions of measurement.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp and the stop lamp (S1, S2 and MS) shall meet, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (see Tables 3, 4, 5, 7 and 8) shown in Figure A3-I.
requirements.quote: The values shown give, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (see Tables 3, 4, 5, 7 and 8).

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall meet, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities in cd shown in Figure A3-V.
requirements.quote: The values shown in figure A3-V give, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities in cd.

requirements.text: For the reversing lamp using light source technology other than incandescent technology, the luminous intensities measured after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.quote: For reversing lamps and manoeuvring lamps, the luminous intensities measured after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation, shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.

requirements.text: For the lamps other than reversing lamps and manoeuvring lamps using light source technology other than incandescent technology, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either after 30 minutes of operation or after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.quote: For all other lamps, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either - after 30 minutes of operation, or - after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.

requirements.text: Operation of the direction indicator lamp shall be done in flashing mode (f = 1.5 Hz, duty factor 50 per cent).
requirements.quote: Operation of direction indicator lamps shall be done in flashing mode (f = 1.5 Hz, duty factor 50 per cent).

requirements.text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.

requirements.text: It shall not be possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.
requirements.quote: In particular, it shall not be possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.

requirements.text: For all light-signalling devices, including those mounted on the side panels, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road.
requirements.quote: For all light-signalling devices, including those mounted on the side panels, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road;

requirements.text: The reference axis of the lamp shall be parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle in the case of all signalling devices other than side retro-reflectors and side-marker lamps.
requirements.quote: in addition it shall be perpendicular to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle in the case of side retro-reflectors and of side-marker lamps and parallel to that plane in the case of all other signalling devices.

requirements.text: In each direction a tolerance of ±3° shall be allowed for the reference axis of the lamp.
requirements.quote: In each direction a tolerance of ±3° shall be allowed.

requirements.text: Any specific instructions as regards fitting laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with.
requirements.quote: In addition, any specific instructions as regards fitting laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the rear combination lamp shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and, in the case where an AFS is installed, with the system in its neutral state.
requirements.quote: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the lamps shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and, in the case where an AFS is installed, with the system in its neutral state.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the rear combination lamps constituting a pair shall be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (this estimate to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.).
requirements.quote: Be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (this estimate to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.);

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the rear combination lamps constituting a pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane, except that this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp.
requirements.quote: Be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane, this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp;

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the rear combination lamps constituting a pair shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
requirements.quote: Satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the rear combination lamps constituting a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics, except that this shall not apply to a matched pair of a function and/or an AFS.
requirements.quote: Have substantially identical photometric characteristics. This shall not apply to a matched pair of a function and/or an AFS.

requirements.text: While lamps are grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another, the lamps shall fulfil all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any.
requirements.quote: Lamps may be grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another provided that all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, are fulfilled.

requirements.text: When all other functions with which a lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF, the lamp shall fulfil its photometric and colorimetric requirements.
requirements.quote: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.

requirements.text: When a front or rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with them, and the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the front or rear position lamps are switched ON, each of these other functions shall fulfil the requirements regarding colour.
requirements.quote: However, when a front or rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with them, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the front or rear position lamps are switched ON.

requirements.text: The single lamp as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), the apparent surface of which is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed in such a way that either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis, or the minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis, except that these requirements do not apply to a single retro-reflector.
requirements.quote: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), the apparent surface of which is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed in such a way that: (a) Either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis; or (b) The minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.

requirements.text: The single lamp as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (d) shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.
requirements.quote: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (d) shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.

requirements.text: The maximum height of the rear combination lamp above the ground shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis, except that where the (maximum and minimum) height above the ground clearly meets the requirements of the Regulation, the exact edges of any surface need not be determined.
requirements.quote: The maximum height above the ground shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis. Where the (maximum and minimum) height above the ground clearly meets the requirements of the Regulation, the exact edges of any surface need not be determined.

requirements.text: For the purposes of reducing the geometric visibility angles, the position of the rear combination lamp with regard to height above the ground shall be measured from the H plane.
requirements.quote: For the purposes of reducing the geometric visibility angles, the position of a lamp with regard to height above the ground, shall be measured from the H plane.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of the rear combination lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
requirements.quote: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of a lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.

requirements.text: The photometric characteristics of the rear combination lamp may vary in relation to the ambient light, as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, or when the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function, provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.quote: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary: (a) In relation to the ambient light; (b) As a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF; or (c) When the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function; provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.

requirements.text: Red light emitted by the rear combination lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.

requirements.text: To verify paragraphs 5.10.1. and 5.10.2., for the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, with the exception of a red rearmost side-marker lamp, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp of the rear combination lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4).
requirements.quote: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, with the exception of a red rearmost side-marker lamp, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4);

requirements.text: To verify paragraphs 5.10.1. and 5.10.2., for the visibility of white light towards the rear of a vehicle, with the exception of reversing lamps and white side conspicuity markings, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a white lamp of the rear combination lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 2 in a transverse plane situated 25 m behind the vehicle (see Annex 4).
requirements.quote: For the visibility of white light towards the rear of a vehicle, with the exception of reversing lamps and white side conspicuity markings, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a white lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 2 in a transverse plane situated 25 m behind the vehicle (see Annex 4);

requirements.text: In case of doubt, when verifying paragraphs 5.10.1. and 5.10.2., the requirement above shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front and/or the white light emitted to the rear, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.
requirements.quote: In case of doubt, the requirement above shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front and/or the white light emitted to the rear, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the rear combination lamp shall be such that the rear position lamp, the end-outline marker lamp, if it exists, the side-marker lamp, if it exists, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously with the front position lamps.
requirements.quote: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.

requirements.text: The stop lamp of the rear combination lamp shall emit red light.
requirements.quote: Stop lamp: Red

requirements.text: The rear position lamp of the rear combination lamp shall emit red light.
requirements.quote: Rear position lamp: Red

requirements.text: The rear fog lamp of the rear combination lamp shall emit red light.
requirements.quote: Rear fog lamp: Red

requirements.text: The direction-indicator lamp of the rear combination lamp shall emit amber light.
requirements.quote: Direction-indicator lamp: Amber

requirements.text: The reversing lamp of the rear combination lamp shall emit white light.
requirements.quote: Reversing lamp: White

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector of the rear combination lamp shall be red.
requirements.quote: Rear retro-reflector, non- triangular: Red Rear retro-reflector, triangular: Red

requirements.text: The rear end-outline marker lamp of the rear combination lamp shall emit red light.
requirements.quote: End-outline marker lamp: White in front, red at the rear

requirements.text: The rear registration plate lamp shall emit white light.
requirements.quote: Rear registration plate lamp: White

requirements.text: The number of lamps of the rear combination lamp mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.

requirements.text: Where the rear combination lamp is installed on movable components, the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. shall be fulfilled.
requirements.quote: Any lamp may be installed on movable components provided that the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. are fulfilled.

requirements.text: Where the rear combination lamp's rear position lamps, rear direction-indicators and rear retro-reflectors, triangular as well as non-triangular, are installed on movable components, the lamps on the movable components shall meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps at all fixed positions of the movable components.
requirements.quote: If at all fixed positions of the movable components the lamps on the movable components meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps.

requirements.text: Where the functions referred to in paragraph 5.18. are obtained by an interdependent lamp system mounted completely on the moving component(s), the interdependent lamp system shall satisfy the requirements of paragraph 5.18.1., except that additional lamps for the above functions may be switched ON when the movable component is in any fixed open position, provided that these additional lamps satisfy all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component.
requirements.quote: (a) Should the complete interdependent lamp system be mounted on the moving component(s), the requirements of paragraph 5.18.1. shall be satisfied. However, additional lamps for the above functions may be switched ON, when the movable component is in any fixed open position, provided that these additional lamps satisfy all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component; or

requirements.text: Where the functions referred to in paragraph 5.18. are obtained by an interdependent lamp system partly mounted on the fixed component and partly on a movable component, with the exception of direction indicator lamps, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, outwards geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).
requirements.quote: (b) Should the interdependent lamp system be partly mounted on the fixed component and partly mounted on a movable component, with the exception of direction indicator lamps, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, outwards geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).

requirements.text: Where the interdependent lamp system is partly mounted on the fixed component and partly on a movable component, the inwards geometric visibility requirement(s) shall be deemed to be satisfied if the interdependent lamp(s) still conform(s) to the photometric values prescribed in the field of light distribution for the approval of the device, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).
requirements.quote: The inwards geometric visibility requirement(s) is(are) deemed to be satisfied if this(these) interdependent lamp(s) still conform(s) to the photometric values prescribed in the field of light distribution for the approval of the device, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).

requirements.text: Where the interdependent lamp system is partly mounted on the fixed component and partly on a movable component, for direction indicator lamps, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, geometric visibility, photometric and colorimetric requirements at all fixed positions of the movable component(s), except that this does not apply where, to fulfil or complete the geometric visibility angle, additional lamps are switched ON when the movable component is in any fixed open position, provided that these additional lamps satisfy all the position, photometric and colorimetric requirements applicable to the direction indicator lamps installed on the movable component.
requirements.quote: For direction indicator lamps, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, geometric visibility, photometric and colorimetric requirements at all fixed positions of the movable component(s). This does not apply where, to fulfil or complete the geometric visibility angle, additional lamps are switched ON when the movable component is in any fixed open position, provided that these additional lamps satisfy all the position, photometric and colorimetric requirements applicable to the direction indicator lamps installed on the movable component.

requirements.text: When the movable components are in a position other than a "normal position of use", the devices installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.
requirements.quote: When the movable components are in a position other than a "normal position of use", the devices installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.

requirements.text: When the rear combination lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.
requirements.quote: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.

requirements.text: In the case of dipped-beam headlamps and front fog lamps, the requirement to return to the specified position shall be considered satisfied if, when the movable components are moved and returned to the normal position 10 times, no value of the angular inclination of these lamps, relative to its support, measured after each operation of the movable component, differs by more than 0.15 per cent from the average of the 10 measured values.
requirements.quote: In the case of dipped-beam headlamps and front fog lamps, this requirement shall be considered satisfied if, when the movable components are moved and returned to the normal position 10 times, no value of the angular inclination of these lamps, relative to its support, measured after each operation of the movable component, differs by more than 0.15 per cent from the average of the 10 measured values.

requirements.text: If the value of 0.15 per cent is exceeded, each limit specified in paragraph 6.2.6.1.1. shall be modified by this excess to decrease the allowed range of inclinations when checking the vehicle according to Annex 6.
requirements.quote: If this value is exceeded each limit specified in paragraph 6.2.6.1.1. shall then be modified by this excess to decrease the allowed range of inclinations when checking the vehicle according to Annex 6.

requirements.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear position lamps, rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".
requirements.quote: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".

requirements.text: If the requirement that the apparent surface not be hidden more than 50 per cent is not practicable, additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the above indicated lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
requirements.quote: Additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the above indicated lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component; or

requirements.text: If the requirement that the apparent surface not be hidden more than 50 per cent is not practicable and additional lamps are not used, a remark in the communication form (item 10.1. of Annex 1) shall inform other Administrations that more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis can be hidden by the movable components.
requirements.quote: A remark in the communication form (item 10.1. of Annex 1) shall inform other Administrations that more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis can be hidden by the movable components; and

requirements.text: If the requirement that the apparent surface not be hidden more than 50 per cent is not practicable and additional lamps are not used, a notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road; for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements for use on the road.
requirements.quote: A notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road; for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements for use on the road.

requirements.text: Where a temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp is provided, the replacement function in case of a failure shall be similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate.
requirements.quote: Any temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp is allowed, provided that the replacement function in case of a failure is similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate

requirements.text: Where a temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp is provided, the replacement device shall remain operational in its original safety function.
requirements.quote: provided that the replacement device remains operational in its original safety function.

requirements.text: During replacement, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
requirements.quote: During replacement, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.

requirements.text: When the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition, the voltage supplied at the terminals of the rear combination lamp, if according to its type approval documentation it has been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved.
requirements.quote: The voltage supplied at the terminals of devices which, according to their type approval documentation, have been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved.

requirements.text: When the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition, in all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the rear combination lamp device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent.
requirements.quote: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent.

requirements.text: Where the rear combination lamp includes an electronic light source control gear, a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128, the provisions of paragraphs 5.27.1. and 5.27.2. shall not apply to the rear combination lamp.
requirements.quote: The provisions of paragraphs 5.27.1. and 5.27.2. shall not apply to devices which include: - an electronic light source control gear, or - a variable intensity control being part of the device, or - only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp shall have no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity, except that no account is taken of obstacles if they were already presented when the lamp was type-approved.
requirements.quote: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity. However, no account is taken of obstacles, if they were already presented when the lamp was type-approved.

requirements.text: If measurements are taken closer to the rear combination lamp, the direction of observation shall be shifted parallel to achieve the same accuracy.
requirements.quote: If measurements are taken closer to the lamp, the direction of observation shall be shifted parallel to achieve the same accuracy.

requirements.text: If, when the rear combination lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
requirements.quote: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.

requirements.text: When installed on a vehicle, the rear combination lamp shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.

requirements.text: Where the rear combination lamp is installed on a vehicle approved according to this Regulation and approved for one or more replaceable light source categories according to Regulations Nos. 37, 99 or 128, the rear combination lamp shall be fitted with light sources approved according to these light source categories only, except that this requirement does not concern light source modules, LED modules and non-replaceable light sources, except for when they are required to be approved by the applicable Regulation.
requirements.quote: Lamps installed on a vehicle which is approved according to this Regulation and approved for one or more replaceable light source categories according to Regulations Nos. 37, 99 or 128, shall be fitted with light sources approved according to these light source categories only. This requirement does not concern light source modules, LED modules and non-replaceable light sources, except for when they are required to be approved by the applicable Regulation.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be present on motor vehicles and on trailers of categories O2, O3 and O4, and may be present on trailers of category O1.
requirements.quote: Presence Mandatory on motor vehicles and on trailers of categories O2, O3 and O4. Optional on trailers of category O1.

requirements.text: On motor vehicles of category M1 and on all other vehicles with a length not exceeding 6,000 mm, one reversing lamp shall be fitted and a second reversing lamp may be fitted.
requirements.quote: One device mandatory and a second device optional on motor vehicles of category M1 and on all other vehicles with a length not exceeding 6,000 mm.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.quote: These devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground, except that for category N2G, N3G, M2G, M3G (off-road) vehicles the maximum height may be increased to 1,400 mm.
requirements.quote: In height: not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground. For category N2G, N3G, M2G, M3G (off-road) vehicles the maximum height may be increased to 1,400 mm.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be positioned, in length, at the rear of the vehicle, except that if installed, the two optional devices mentioned in paragraph 6.4.2.2. may be fitted on the side of the vehicle, provided that the requirements of paragraphs 6.4.5.2. and 6.4.6.2. below are fulfilled.
requirements.quote: In length: at the rear of the vehicle However, if installed, the two optional devices mentioned in paragraph 6.4.2.2. may be fitted on the side of the vehicle, provided that the requirements of paragraphs 6.4.5.2. and 6.4.6.2. below are fulfilled.

requirements.text: For reversing lamp devices installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility shall be defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.: α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device, 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two.
requirements.quote: Devices installed at the rear of the vehicle: Defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.: α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device, 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.quote: Rearwards

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the reversing lamp shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.quote: They shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.

requirements.text: If either the reverse gear is not engaged or the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is not in a position that makes operation of the propulsion system possible, the reversing lamp shall not switch ON or remain ON.
requirements.quote: It shall not switch ON or remain ON if either of the above conditions is not satisfied.

requirements.text: The stop lamp devices of S1 or S2 categories shall be mandatory on all categories of vehicles.
requirements.quote: Devices of S1 or S2 categories: mandatory on all categories of vehicles.

requirements.text: The stop lamp devices of S3 or S4 category shall be mandatory on M1 and N1 categories of vehicles, except for chassis-cabs and those N1 category vehicles with open cargo space.
requirements.quote: Devices of S3 or S4 category: mandatory on M1 and N1 categories of vehicles, except for chassis-cabs and those N1 category vehicles with open cargo space; optional on other categories of vehicles.

requirements.text: The vehicle shall have two S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices and one S3 or S4 category stop lamp device on all categories of vehicles.
requirements.quote: Two S1 or S2 category devices and one S3 or S4 category device on all categories of vehicles.

requirements.text: The stop lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.quote: The devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, the point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the S1 or S2 category stop lamp that is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle;

requirements.text: The stop lamp of S1 or S2 categories shall be positioned above the ground not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm, except that the maximum height may be 2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed.
requirements.quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices: Above the ground, not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).

requirements.text: If the optional lamps are installed, the optional stop lamps of S1 or S2 categories shall be positioned at a height compatible with the requirements of the width and the symmetry of the lamps, and at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible, but not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.
requirements.quote: If the optional lamps are installed, they shall be positioned at a height compatible with the requirements of the width and the symmetry of the lamps, and at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible, but not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.

requirements.text: The stop lamp of S1 or S2 categories shall be positioned at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices: at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The stop lamp of S1 or S2 categories shall have a geometric visibility horizontal angle of 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle, except that for stop lamps of categories S1 and S2 mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices: 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle. However, for the stop lamps of categories S1 and S2 mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.

requirements.text: The stop lamp of S1 or S2 categories shall have a geometric visibility vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that (a) where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°; (b) where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices: 15° above and below the horizontal. However, (a) Where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°; (b) Where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall be oriented towards the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: Orientation Towards the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: When the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H, all stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously.
requirements.quote: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp of R or R1 or R2 categories shall be mandatory.
requirements.quote: Presence Devices of R or R1 or R2 categories: Mandatory

requirements.text: The number of rear position lamps shall be two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.quote: Two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
